thread:
raj (Cloud Partnerships): hey team — partner asked for a slim set of terraform snippets and a compatibility table for our ref‑archs across aws/azure/gcp, incl arm64 (graviton/ampere) build notes. want to avoid 20 different modules. thoughts? :wave:

emma (Partner Eng): +1. can we standardize on a core module + cloud-specific wrappers? that makes marketplace packaging easier. :thumbsup:

maria (Templates): I can own the starter templates. quick Q: do partners need examples for both marketplace listing + airgapped onprem?

raj (Cloud Partnerships): ideally both. the marketplace examples should include licensing metadata and minimal deploy hooks; onprem should show a simple local provider override and KMS/HSM stub.

oliver (Solutions): agree on core+wrappers. also want a short `smoke` workflow for each module that runs `terraform init && plan` on linux/arm64 and linux/x86 CI runners. keeps regressions low.

kai (Security): add a note about defaulting to least‑privilege IAM and a block showing how to enable customer‑managed keys. also include an artifact scanning step in CI.

emma (Partner Eng): I'm happy to draft the compatibility matrix. propose cols: cloud, region families (x86/arm), marketplace required metadata, recommended instance types, known perf notes.

maria (Templates): sample provider snippet I was thinking to include:
```hcl
provider "aws" {
  region = var.region
  # set this to "arm64" for Graviton images in AMI lookups
  architecture = var.architecture // "x86" | "arm64"
}
```

raj (Cloud Partnerships): perfect — add a tiny README in each example that lists testing steps and expected outputs. partners really like a 5‑minute quickstart.

deploy-bot: Deployed commit 9a3f2 to refs/partners/refkit-examples (main) — CI passed on linux-x86, failing on linux-arm64 (missing `qemu-user-static`).

emma (Partner Eng): thanks bot — for ARM CI let’s add emulation or use arm runners in GH actions. i’ll add a note to the matrix about CI status per cloud.

oliver (Solutions): one last ask: include a tiny cost/size note per reference deployment (e.g., 2x g4dn vs 1x graviton large) so customers understand economics. ties back to our Optimize messaging.

raj (Cloud Partnerships): timeline? can we have a first pass (templates + matrix + CI runbook) by EOD next Wednesday?

maria (Templates): i can push starter templates by Tue EOD, CI configs included.

emma (Partner Eng): matrix draft Wed morning, will ping partners for missing instance families.

kai (Security): i'll drop a KMS/HSM checklist and minimal IAM example by Wed.

raj (Cloud Partnerships): awesome. i'll coordinate partner review and marketplace metadata checklist. tagging @oliver to prep cost note. thanks all. :rocket:

oliver (Solutions): noted. will sketch cost notes and add links to perf runs.

raj (Cloud Partnerships): followups — please PR to https://git.redwood.ai/partner-refkit and use `examples/compact` layout. we want one tiny example per cloud plus a combined multi‑cloud demo.

maria (Templates): will do. also adding a CONTRIBUTING.md with required linting: `tflint`, `tfsec`, and `pre-commit` hooks.

emma (Partner Eng): can we add a short checklist for marketplace packaging: icons, description length, allowed billing flags? partners keep tripping on this.

raj (Cloud Partnerships): yes. i'll add a checklist doc and pair with growth for marketplace submission notes.

deploy-bot: Reminder: upcoming branch protection rule requires 2 approvals for partner-* merges.

raj (Cloud Partnerships): good catch. we'll get reviews lined up. thanks everyone.

oliver (Solutions): +1. small and opinionated is the win here.

maria (Templates): posting initial PR in ~2h. anyone wants early look ping me.

emma (Partner Eng): pinged. will review after matrix draft. :mag:

kai (Security): will glance at IAM/KMS quickly after my meeting.

raj (Cloud Partnerships): closing loop — next checkin Friday 10am PT. agenda: matrix status, CI green on arm, marketplace checklist draft.

emma (Partner Eng): see you then.

oliver (Solutions): thanks all.
